Menu

What visitors mention

Pizzas named on the pizzeria's public ordering menu. No prices shown here. Photos are illustrative stock images.

  • Detroit-Style Cheese

    Thick Detroit crust with a three-cheese blend, signature red sauce on top after baking. Cut into six squares.

  • Detroit-Style Pepperoni

    Cup-and-char pepperoni over the three-cheese blend, red sauce on top.

  • Detroit-Style Sausage

    Italian sausage over the three-cheese blend, red sauce on top.

  • Detroit-Style Pepperoni & Sausage

    Cup-and-char pepperoni and sausage together, red sauce on top.

  • Detroit Fries

    Garlic-sauce cheese bread cut into twelve fries, red sauce on the side.

  • CBR (Chicken Bacon Ranch)

    Creamy ranch sauce, chopped chicken, crispy bacon and fresh onion, finished with a ranch drizzle.

  • D'Pesto-Roni

    Garlic sauce and pesto with cup-and-char pepperoni, finished with a pesto drizzle.

  • Photo coming soon — mortadella, ricotta dollops and crushed pistachios

    D'Rick and Morty

    November Pizza of the Month: mortadella, ricotta dollops, pesto drizzle and crushed pistachios.

The concept

A full page, built around the favourites

This demo turns the pizzas on the public ordering menu into a complete visit — menu, gallery, and directions in one place.

The menu above lists the pizzas named on the pizzeria's online ordering menu, and every photo on this page is illustrative stock — not photography of this business. What this concept adds is structure: the favourites up front, the visit details in one place, and a clear next step at the bottom.

D'Addario's serves two towns — Amery on Birch Street East, and New Richmond inside Sweet Beet Bakery on Knowles Ave. Ordering is online for pickup, and only a limited number of pizzas are made each day, so ordering ahead matters. If anything here looks out of date, the fastest check is a phone call or a message on Facebook.
